'''October 2000 Maryland tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Maryland on 15 October 2000. [[Mike Gandy]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1353">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-maryland-15-oct-00d1353/ maryland-15-oct-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-maryland-15-oct-00d1353/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Maryland
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Gandy]]
